notes: Account: centralized support org for multi-brand ecommerce retail + fintech product lines.
Primary ask: Dedicated capacity for 24/7 support (reserved throughput) — cannot absorb noisy neighbor impact.
Use-case details: real-time agent assist (in-channel suggestions), automated ticket summarization for triage, outbound tool-calling to CRM and fulfillment tools, and reranking of KB search results.
SLA requirement: target 99.95% availability for critical queues; p95 latency target for agent-assist actions <= 250ms (interactive UX).
Traffic profile: baseline 1.2k concurrent agent sessions U.S. PST hours; planned spikes up to 6k concurrent during promos (Black Friday-level).
Cost sensitivity: care about per-token economics for high-volume summarization; willing to trade larger model for cost if quality delta small — interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations.
Security: must support BYOK/KMS, SSO via SAML, audit logs for agent prompts and redaction, data residency for EU customer records; retention controls to purge PII on demand.
Model preferences: prefer open/quantized models for cost + auditability, request fallbacks to smaller model family when capacity constrained; deterministic reranker for ticket prioritization.
Integrations: Zendesk + Salesforce Service Cloud + in-house fulfillment API; need function/tool calling to execute ticket updates and fulfillment checks (idempotency required).
Quote from director on call: 'We need predictable behavior during peak sales windows — zero surprise throttles that break agent flows.'
Internal stakeholders: VP Support (exec sponsor), Head of Infra (wants VPC + audit), Security (SOC2 + contract redlines), Procurement (term negotiation).

POC success criteria: p95 latency < 250ms for 2k concurrent simulated agents; seamless Zendesk tool-call demo; evidence of KV/prefix cache improving latency on repeat prompts; security questionnaire completed.
